action.title: Ironclad
action.text: A bomb-disposal veteran must escort a stolen armored prototype train across a mountain range before its buyer's private army catches up.

anta.r: the arms dealer who wants it back

action.title: Dead Reckoning at Sea
action.text: A getaway driver on her last job learns the vault she's robbing sits under a cruise ship that someone else is already hijacking.

side.r: the safecracker who never stops talking

anta.r: the pirate captain running the hijack

action.title: Canyon Fire
action.text: A former smuggler turned park ranger races a wildfire and a rogue militia to evacuate a canyon town through the only road left.

anta.r: the militia leader who wants the road closed

scifi.title: Tidal Lock
scifi.text: When the Earth stops spinning, a climatologist leads a convoy along the one thin strip of twilight that's still livable.

anta.r: the billionaire hoarding the last greenhouse

scifi.title: The Understudy
scifi.text: A cloned stage actor learns the original has been missing for years, and that he was grown to take his place.

anta.r: the original, who comes back

scifi.title: Signal Fire
scifi.text: A forest lookout starts hearing a transmission in her radio static that predicts disasters one day before they happen.

anta.r: the agency that buried similar reports

animation.title: Pepper and the Tide
animation.text: A timid lighthouse apprentice crab must keep a very sleepy sea monster from wrecking the village's summer fair.

anta.r: the fair's snobbish mayor

anta.r: the thundercloud that hates deliveries

animation.title: Grandma's Robot
animation.text: A retired robot vacuum teaches a lonely kid how to save his grandmother's bakery from a gleaming robot franchise.

anta.r: the franchise's slick CEO

comedy.title: Family Style

side.r: the sous-chef who knows the secret recipe

anta.r: the food critic who never smiles

comedy.text: Old college friends get locked in an escape room for their reunion, and every puzzle is built from their secrets.

side.r: the friend with the biggest secret

anta.r: the unseen game master

comedy.text: A wedding crasher is mistaken for the officiant and can't find a way to back out before the vows.

anta.r: the wedding planner who runs everything

horror.title: Static Hours
horror.text: A late-night radio host starts taking calls from listeners who describe the inside of her own house.

side.r: the caller who keeps ringing back

anta.r: the voice that answers from inside the house

horror.title: Salt House
horror.text: A family buys a flooded village's old hotel where the guests never actually checked out.

anta.r: the proprietor who never leaves the lobby

horror.title: Floor 13

anta.r: the tenant on thirteen

thriller.title: Blind Spot
thriller.text: A security-camera analyst realizes the same stranger has stood in the background of every incident for five years.

anta.r: the stranger in the background

thriller.title: Last Ferry
thriller.text: Passengers on the final night ferry learn that one of them holds a ticket for a crime that hasn't happened yet.

anta.r: the detective aboard who wants it unsolved

side.r: the retired judge who helps her

anta.r: the senior partner running the firm

drama.title: Harbor Light

anta.r: the cannery owner buying up the harbor

drama.title: Second Violin

anta.r: the donor threatening to pull the funding

drama.text: A son returns to his late father's island to deliver the last letters, and learns the secret his father kept.

anta.r: the landowner who wants the island's history buried

romance.title: Layover
romance.text: Two strangers stuck in a Reykjavik airport for 24 hours keep missing their flights on purpose.

anta.r: the ex waiting at the destination

romance.title: Tuesday Night Club
romance.text: A widowed baker and her new neighbor start a weekly dinner club that matchmakes everyone except themselves.

anta.r: the rival matchmaker

romance.title: Letters to August
romance.text: Two pen pals fall for each other across two cities, then discover they work for rival companies.

lead.r: the pen pal in the city

side.r: the pen pal across the bay

anta.r: the CEO who wants both fired
